items.title: Use Codex skill invocation instead of unsupported slash commands
items.note: Roadmap now opens correctly from Codex using its native skill picker.

items.title: Consolidate Codex hooks into config.toml
items.note: Codex starts cleanly without duplicate hook configuration warnings.

items.title: Audience leak guard: DEMOTE tier for developer/API-surface work + lint gate when explicitly setting audience public
items.note: The changelog now warns before developer-facing work (API keys, posting APIs, admin tooling) slips into the public notes.

items.title: Worktree-aware serve/orient: detect git worktrees, warn when dashboard serves a stale branch's roadmap vs main checkout
Combined all-worktrees view as the serve dashboard default
Live worktree re-discovery in serve — added/deleted checkouts update the dashboard
Serve reprints unchanged status on every file touch — skip identical payloads
Auto-release nudge: when current version hits 100%, prompt or auto-run roadmap release before starting next version
items.note: Finished versions get cut automatically: when every item in the current version is done, the roadmap offers (or runs) the release for you before new work starts.

items.title: Internal notes can leak into the public changelog: unset-audience bugs default public and demote tells only advise
items.note: The public changelog is now protected: unclassified work stays in the internal log, saving a public note requires an explicit audience, and internal-sounding wording is refused at save time.

items.title: Typed human-readable ID prefixes (TSK-42, BUG-7) as display layer over int ids
items.note: Items now show friendly typed IDs like FEAT-12 and BUG-7 in status, next, and commit suggestions — and you can reference them either way.

items.title: Acceptance criteria section as first-class part of plan templates
items.note: Plan templates now include an Acceptance section so reviews check work against explicit pass/fail criteria.

items.title: Filtered listing and search: status --type/--version filters, plus search and stats subcommands
items.note: Find things faster: filter status by type or version, and search titles, notes, and plans from the CLI.

items.title: promote leaves the incubator notes-link text in the promoted item title and slug
